{{Quote|We're returning to base under our own power.''"<br />"''Begging your pardon, Captain, but didn't you say the base was probably being watched?''"<br />"''I’m sure it is being watched.|Arwen Cohl and Jalan|<ref name="CoD" />}}
This '''base''' was the headquarters of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Arwen Cohl]]<ref name="CoD" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]]<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]]. It was where Cohl and his team staged their [[Dorvalla Incident|attack]], orchestrated by the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group [[Nebula Front]], on the ''[[Revenue]]'', a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class freighter]] collecting cargo above Dorvalla.<ref name="CoD" /> 

After their successful infiltration of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], during which they stole its secret cargo of [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] ingots, Cohl and the surviving members of his team attempted to return to the base in their shuttle, despite Cohl suspecting that the base had been discovered and was most likely under surveillance. While on their way, the [[Dorvalla Space Corps]] spotted them and asked for their identification. On Cohl's orders, [[Rella]], their [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], crashed their shuttle in the forest near the base, faking their deaths. With only Cohl, Rella, and [[Boiny]] surviving the crash, the three of them continued on foot towards the base, where Cohl's personal ship, the ''[[Hawk-Bat (gunship)|Hawk-Bat]]'', was waiting to pick the survivors up.<ref name="CoD" />
